references.text: Jesus' confirmation that He is sent by the Father, parallel to the claim in 7:29 that He knows the Father and has been sent by Him.
Jesus' own statement that He came from the Father and was sent into the world, reflecting the theme of origin and sending in 7:29.
Jesus' prayer where He confirms that He has come from the Father and is sent by Him, a direct echo of the identity declaration in 7:29.
The Father's testimony that He has sent the Son, supporting Jesus' claim in 7:29 that the Father has sent Him.
Jesus' explanation that He does not speak on His own authority but speaks as the Father commanded, based on the relationship and sending mentioned in 7:29.
